messages:
sam (support): FYI customer #8421 reporting canary rollout health tiles in Console show 'In progress' for 45+ mins even though the rollout backend shows finished and events stream has final event. ticket: https://zendesk.company/8421 :exclamation:
emma (eng-frontend): Can you paste the console screenshot or a short repro? is this only the UI or do the per-rollout metrics also show stale?
sam (support): Screenshot attached in ticket. UI tiles + per-rollout timeline both show the spinner. API /rollouts/:id/status returns state=ROLLED_OUT. frontend console still shows progress.
jin (sre): Likely status-sync pipeline lag or missing status event delivery. tagging @emma for UI cache idea. Can you check the status-sync worker logs?
emma (eng-frontend): I tried hard refresh and clearing local cache, no change. I can reproduce on prod in eu-west-1 with rollout id r-0a1b2c.
sam (support): Repro steps in ticket: 1) open Console -> Rollouts -> select r-0a1b2c 2) see spinner 3) curl -s https://api.redwood.ai/rollouts/r-0a1b2c/status returns JSON with state:"ROLLED_OUT"
jin (sre): Running quick checks: ```kubectl -n infra logs status-sync-worker-5f7d | tail -n 200``` shows repeated: "WARN 2025-11-02T08:12:01Z StatusEvent dropped: missing target_state key" and also consumer lag for topic rollout-status is 0.
emma (eng-frontend): Huh missing key might explain why UI state isn't updated because frontend relies on normalized 'target_state' from sync service.
luis (product): How many customers affected? Is this a single-customer corrupt event or a systemic transformation issue?
sam (support): So far only this customer reported, but internal telemetry shows ~0.1% of events in last 24h had schema mismatch. I attached a sample event from the event-log: ```{"event_id":"e-123","rollout_id":"r-0a1b2c","state":"ROLLED_OUT","stage":"canary","metadata":{}}``` note no 'target_state' field.
jin (sre): The status-sync service got a schema tightening in v1.14 that expects 'target_state' when stage=="canary". Looks like older emitters still send only 'state'. Worker currently drops those events rather than mapping. That's bad.
emma (eng-frontend): Frontend renders based on status-sync snapshots. If events get dropped, tiles never update.
jin (sre): Quick mitigation: add a fallback mapping in the sync worker to populate target_state from state when absent, and backfill recent events. Plan: push hotfix branch, run in canary, then restart sync workers.
emma (eng-frontend): Will the frontend pick up snapshot once the worker republishes? yes?
jin (sre): Yes the worker republishes snapshots to /snapshots/rollouts/{id}. After republish frontend requests get the corrected snapshot.
sam (support): I posted a note in Zendesk that engineering is investigating and offered a status call. customer is okay waiting for fix but wants ETA.
luis (product): Estimate?
jin (sre): Hotfix PR: https://git.company/redwood/status-sync/pulls/211 — small change in processors/schema_adapter.py to fallback to state. If tests pass, can canary deploy in 20-30m, full rollout + restart workers 1h after. ETA to customer: ~90m.
emma (eng-frontend): Also adding UI-side guard to treat missing target_state same as state to avoid future visible gaps. I'll open a tiny PR after jin's.
deploy-bot: Deploy triggered for status-sync hotfix (canary): deploy/status-sync/211 -> canary-2 :rocket:
jin (sre): After canary deploy, I restarted one sync worker and backfill script ran, republished 120 snapshots. I see logs: "INFO republished snapshot for r-0a1b2c"
emma (eng-frontend): Confirmed in prod (eu-west-1) the rollout tile updated to 'Healthy' for r-0a1b2c. UI timeline matches API now. :tada:
sam (support): Told customer fix is deployed and snapshots republished. Customer confirmed UI cleared. Closing ticket after final verification.
luis (product): Follow-ups: create alert for dropped-events > 1/min, add a compatibility test in CI for schema variants, and add a short KB article for customers about transient UI sync delays.
jin (sre): Filed follow-up issues: https://issues.company/RED-4923 (alert), RED-4924 (ci test). Also adding postmortem note to runbook.
sam (support): Thanks team. I'll send a brief note to support rotation and update the incident tracker.
zendesk-bot: Ticket #8421 status updated -> pending resolution.
